entries.description: Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, session-set-authoring-guide.md, ai-led-session-workflow.md, spike proposal + tri-provider review, helper-and-pattern-inventory. Verified API keys. Registered session start.

Routed analysis (Gemini Pro) authored ai-assignment.md per workflow Step 3.5 schema. Recommends Sonnet 4.6 for Session 1 (current orchestrator is Opus 4.7). Saved to docs/session-sets/crud-scaffolding/ai-assignment.md.

Routed contract unification analysis (Gemini Pro). Decision: GridQueryRequest + supporting types in AcmeCoffeeOnline.Shared.DTOs; POST /api/{entity}s/query [FromBody]. New file: src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Shared/DTOs/GridQueryRequest.cs.

Confirmed no IQueryable extension exists. Routed implementation (Gemini Pro refactoring). Authored QueryableExtensions.cs in AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Infrastructure with ApplyGridCompositeFilter + ApplyGridQuerySorts. Fixed null-constant bug for non-nullable value types.

Transport decision documented: POST /api/{entity}s/query [FromBody] (nested CompositeFilter cannot serialize to URL query string). Authored request-contract-decision.md and qbe-helper-api.md. Unit test QueryableExtensionsTests.cs — 9 tests, all passing.
dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln — 0 errors, 257 pre-existing warnings. dotnet test (non-integration filter): 9 + 57 + 130 + 16 + 132 = 344 tests passed, 0 failed.

Round 1 verification (GPT-5.4): ISSUES_FOUND. Critical: object? Value deserialises as JsonElement over HTTP. Major: nullable value-type constant expression invalid. Minor: doc inconsistency on 'internal' vs 'public'.
Round 2 verification (GPT-5.4): ISSUES_FOUND. Nullable fix insufficient — Expression.Equal between Nullable<T> member and T constant throws without Expression.Convert lift.

Round 3 verification (GPT-5.4): VERIFIED. All three issues resolved. BuildTypedConstant now wraps with Expression.Convert for nullable types. JsonElement path proven by 2 new tests. 13/13 tests passing.
Cost report, ai-assignment actuals, next-session recommendation (Opus @ effort=low for Session 2), disposition.json authored.
Read project-guidance, lessons-learned, session-set-authoring-guide, Session 1 outputs (request-contract-decision.md, qbe-helper-api.md), and spec.md Session 2 plan.

Promoted GridQueryRequest + QueryableExtensions out of AcmeCoffeeOnline.* into new packable library Dabbler.Api.Querying (per user direction after escalating Session-1/Session-2 placement gap). Added GridQueryResponse<T> for scaffold self-containment. Wired csproj reference into AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api, updated using-statement in QueryableExtensionsTests.cs.
Added Dabbler.Api.Querying to solution, tools/pack.ps1 InRepoPackageIds + LibraryProjects, and Dabbler.Packaging.Smoke PackagingSmokeTests required-IDs.
Updated request-contract-decision.md + qbe-helper-api.md with Session 2 amendment notes recording the placement promotion.

Authored templates/Dabbler.Templates/content/dabbler-crud-service/: .template.config/template.json declaring 11 parameters (entity, entityPlural, apiNamespace, dtoNamespace, sharedNamespace, entityNamespace, dbContextType, dbContextNamespace, pkType, pkRouteConstraint, schema (forward-compat)); Services/IT1EntityService.cs (interface — Query/GetById/Create/Update/Delete using GridQueryRequest+Response); Services/T1EntityService.cs (EF Core impl calling ApplyGridCompositeFilter/ApplyGridQuerySorts, ApplyScope hook, MapToDto/MapToEntity/CopyTo seams, ClampPaging); Controllers/T2EntityPluralController.cs (POST /query + GET/POST/PUT/DELETE with [DabblerEndpointAuthorize] attributes before mutations). Non-overlapping T1..T10 substitution tokens; replaces + fileRename declared on entity/entityPlural to rename files.

Authored tests/Dabbler.Templates.Tests/: csproj with Fixtures content-include (no compile); CrudServiceTemplateTests.cs SkippableFact covering install + scaffold + restore + build; Fixtures/SmokeApi/ skeleton (SmokeApi.csproj with explicit versions, Smoke.cs entity, SmokeDto.cs, Data/SmokeDbContext.cs, Program.cs); Fixtures/smoke.dabbler-entity.json schema fixture.
dotnet build solution → 0 errors. tools/pack.ps1 produced 15 nupkgs including Dabbler.Api.Querying. dotnet test Dabbler.Templates.Tests → 1 passed (scaffold + build smoke).
Cross-provider verification round 1 via gpt-5-4 ($0.142). ISSUES_FOUND: 1 Critical mapping stub, 2 Major spec/doc, 1 Minor test gap.
Cross-provider verification round 2 via gpt-5-4 ($0.191). ISSUES_FOUND: 2 Major correctness + 1 Major spec + 1 Minor doc.
Cross-provider verification round 3 via gpt-5-4 ($0.145). ISSUES_FOUND: 2 Minor docs only — fixed inline per workflow rule 6 (Minor does not block commit). Net VERIFIED_WITH_INLINE_MINOR_FIXES.
Routed analysis via Gemini Pro ($0.003) recommended Opus 4.7 @ max effort for Session 3. Updated ai-assignment.md.
Authored disposition.json: VERIFIED_WITH_INLINE_MINOR_FIXES, 3 verification rounds, files_changed list, Session 3 next-orchestrator recommendation.
